ClassInsight.//AllowOpenTeacherMode: When true, teachers join with no code (trusted lab VLAN). Set false to require TeacherCode.
ClassInsight.//AllowStrongControlsInOpenMode: In open mode, also allow the strongest controls: log off / restart / shut down, internet off and closing programs. Off by default because without a code anyone on the network can act as a teacher.
ClassInsight.//TeacherCode: Used only when AllowOpenTeacherMode is false. Empty + closed mode => the server generates a random code at startup and prints it to the console.
ClassInsight.//Port: Kestrel HTTPS (TLS-only) port for the SignalR hub. Must match Protocol.DefaultServerPort unless clients are told otherwise via discovery.
ClassInsight.//CertificatePath: Optional. A PFX to use as the server's TLS identity. Empty => a self-signed certificate is created once in %ProgramData%\ClassInsight\Server and reused; its fingerprint is printed at start-up. Back it up: replacing it changes the fingerprint every agent and teacher has pinned.
ClassInsight.//DiscoveryEnabled: UDP broadcast discovery on port 47800. Leave true on a normal lab LAN; clients can still connect by typing the server address when broadcast is blocked.
ClassInsight.//IceServers: Optional STUN/TURN relay for segmented networks where student and teacher can't reach each other directly, e.g. [ { "Urls": "turn:10.0.0.5:3478", "Username": "lab", "Credential": "secret" } ]. Empty on a flat lab LAN.
